source.title: Jongno 3-ga: The Insider's Guide to the World's Coolest Neighborhood

hooks: Published Oct 17, 2026; the article already embeds a Google Map of the neighborhood sections (source article)
Picks Gongdeok on the Galmaegisal alleys for a charcoal BBQ night, noting it was on Parts Unknown (source article)
Calls Hadong Jip on Nostalgia Alley by Nagwon Arcade one of his favorites (source article)

list.title: Jongno 3-ga eats & nightlife, from ZenKimchi's insider guide
list.desc: Places from ZenKimchi's 'Jongno 3-ga: The Insider's Guide to the World's Coolest Neighborhood' (https://zenkimchi.com/podcast/jongno-3-ga-the-insiders-guide-to-the-worlds-coolest-neighborhood/). Collected by PinWith, not made by ZenKimchi.

items.title: Tapgol Park (탑골공원)
items.memo: Former temple grounds with a stone pagoda; the guide's starting landmark.

items.title: Chicken Baengi (치킨뱅이)
items.memo: 1990s fried chicken chain; guide suggests the Sejong Set (plain, yangnyeom, garlic).
items.check: chain; guide places it on the east side of the Songhae section, this Donhwamun-ro branch is assumed

items.title: Big Bar
items.memo: Third-floor whiskey bar in the Songhae section.
items.check: name match only; listing in Nagwon-dong, floor/section not confirmed

items.title: Jongno 3-ga Pocha Street (포장마차 거리)
items.memo: Street-food tents by Exits 4-5; try chicken gizzards or boneless spicy feet.

items.title: Salt Pond (Soha Salt Pond)
items.memo: Salt bread bakery with sweet and savory versions, incl. seaweed & fish roe.
items.check: guide says 'Salt Pond'; Google lists 'Soha Salt Pond Ikseon-dong'

items.title: Sikmul (식물)
items.memo: Hanok cafe with hidden rooms; coffee and bread by day, cocktails too.

items.title: Craft Roo
items.memo: Craft beer spot known for its Thai sausage pizza; service can be slow.

items.title: Jang & Paste (장앤페이스트)
items.memo: Italian-Korean: gochujang pastas, sujebi in truffle cream. Book on CatchTable.

items.title: Nagwon Arcade (낙원상가)
items.memo: Instrument market upstairs, traditional market in the basement.

items.title: Cheon Nyeon Jazz Club (천년동안도)
items.memo: Live jazz club just outside Nagwon Arcade.

items.title: EDLS (이들스)
items.memo: 1940s-style club in Nagwon Arcade; jazz & rock, house beer, 10-15k won cover.

items.title: Hadong Jip (하동집)
items.memo: Gukbap spot on Nostalgia Alley south of Nagwon Arcade; an author favorite.
